column1: # Builders in a Box - project template catalogue (FEAT-036).
# One row per template, TAB separated, 7 columns, no blank column:
#   name  kind  stack  time  licences  source  description
#   kind=spec      source is a ready-written FEAT, relative to payload/ (copied to specs/draft/)
#   kind=skeleton  source is a directory holding BRIEF.md and skeleton/ (copied to the project root)
#   stack=cloud    needs a cloud account or a domain: left out of the first-day list
#   licences       SPDX list of what the template ships, or none
# "Describe your own idea" is not a row: it is fixed in the walk (IDEA-BRIEF.md).

column7: Personal Slack coach: an empathic AI in your Slack that knows what is running on this box.
Personal finance dashboard: bank CSV, AI categorisation and fund prices, shipped to a domain you own.
